description: Disposition of the five commons crates that magic-context does not depend on, and of the source repository's fuzz, probe, catalog, CI, and publication artifacts. Registry state is measured with `GET https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/<name>`; each entry records the response digest. The source README's publication table was stale (it listed cortexkit-provider-usage at 0.4.1; the registry serves 0.7.0).

crates.name: cortexkit-paths
crates.rationale: Published; unknown registry consumers may resolve it (claustrum compiles a registry copy). Stays available and unyanked per R21. No Eidnara consumer needs it: the four migrated crates do not depend on it and magic-context does not import it.

crates.name: cortexkit-provider-usage
crates.rationale: Published through 0.7.0, none yanked. Stays available and unyanked per R21. No Eidnara consumer.

crates.name: cortexkit-model-catalog
crates.rationale: Unpublished, no magic-context dependency, no consumer in scope. Source stays readable in the archived repository.

crates.name: cortexkit-push-seal
crates.rationale: Unpublished, no magic-context dependency. Its property catalog (`docs/property-catalog/cortexkit-push-seal/catalog.md`) stays in the archived source per R31 and does not enter the active Eidnara catalog.

crates.name: cortexkit-store-postgres
crates.rationale: Unpublished second storage backend with no consumer in scope (no downstream `PostgresStore` use was found by the source inventory). Its checks are cited in the shared-primitives catalog as archived provenance only. Retiring the matching `StorageBackend::Postgres` variant from storage-types is architecture candidate C1, deferred behind the R18 golden-vector pin.

artifacts.evidence: `git grep -il fuzz` at the source commit matches only catalog prose (`docs/property-catalog/cortexkit-push-seal/catalog.md`, the lease check inventory, and the lease system model); no fuzz crate, target, or workflow exists.
No probe binary, script, or workflow exists at the source commit; the word appears only in the lease catalog's instrumentation notes.
`docs/property-catalog/cortexkit-push-seal/catalog.md` belongs to a dropped crate (R31). The lease catalog is the only catalog for a migrated crate and moved to `docs/properties/shared-primitives/`.

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows on stable. Eidnara's `ci.yml` runs Rust 1.89 and stable on `ubuntu-latest` only: the genesis release ships `linux-x64-gnu` only, and the Windows-only `cortexkit-paths` canonicalization vectors belong to a frozen crate.
The `postgres` job tests `cortexkit-store-postgres` against a service container; the backend is dropped.
The `actual_git_diff_requires_version_bump` gate belongs to `cortexkit-push-seal`, which is dropped.
`.github/scripts/resolve-release-tag.sh` and its test exist to publish crates from `<crate>-v<version>` tags; every Eidnara crate is `publish = false`.

Tag-triggered `cargo publish` per crate (`docs/releasing.md`). No Eidnara crate publishes (R21); the four migrated crates were never published, so no registry successor question arises. The source workflow is disabled by the mechanical freeze in U8 (KTD18).
`migration/owners.json` `released_duties[0]` records the storage and lease review duty as released to the single maintainer, citing the source README ownership section.
